description:
Why this issue exists: change_log.rs append_change() only ever records a 'created' change type. There is no path that records 'updated' (keyword changes, flag changes) or 'destroyed' (deletion) changes. RFC 8621 §4.4 Email/changes is required to return accurate created/updated/destroyed sets so that JMAP clients can sync incrementally.

What needs to be done: Add 'updated' records when email keywords or mailbox membership changes, and 'destroyed' records when an email is expunged. The change_log schema and append_change() signature likely need a change_type enum parameter. Without this, JMAP clients using Email/changes will miss all mutations after initial import, breaking incremental sync.
title: change_log: only records 'created'; Email/changes misses updates/destroys
